SELECT PORTFOLIO_ID id, PORTFOLIO_NAME text FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO
PORTFOLIO_ID LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{search},'%')) OR PORTFOLIO_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{search},'%'))

SELECT FINPROD_MARKET_ID id, FINPROD_ABBR text FROM FIN_PRODUCT WHERE FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINTYPE_F01,jdbcType = VARCHAR}
AND (FINPROD_MARKET_ID LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{search},'%')) OR FINPROD_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{search},'%')))

SELECT distinct n.COUNTER_ID id, n.COUNTER_NAME text FROM FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT m LEFT JOIN MST_COUNTER_PARTY n on m.COUNTER_ID = n.COUNTER_ID WHERE m.FINPROD_TYPE2 in ('F02', 'F04', 'F15', 'F29')
AND (n.COUNTER_ID LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{search},'%')) OR n.COUNTER_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{search},'%')))

select t.seq_no seqNo,t.trade_id tradeId,t.finprod_id finprodId,t.branch,t.trade_type tradeType,t.pledge_displace_amt pledgeDisplaceAmt,t.scale,t.first_netprice firstNetprice from fin_pledge_displace_detail t
WHERE t.trade_id=#{tradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
